body.name: Main switching optimal acquisition cost \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction:
Define the main switching acquisition optimum by
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =\inf\{\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}):
          E_{\mathrm{sw}}\text{ is a switching acquisition certificate and }
          \operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\},
 \qquad \inf\varnothing=+\infty.
\]
This is an acquisition-cost optimization over source certificates; it is not a scalar identifying functional for \(Q\).
